messages:
Sofia: heads-up 1 - new bootcamp cohort hit a strict schema failure in jsonMode when invoking function calls. the JS quickstart helper is leaking an internal meta field into the function arguments: `_sdk_ts`. server schema has `additionalProperties: false` and rejects the payload. repro + logs below.

Sofia: repro (node quickstart):
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true });
await client.chat.complete({
  model: 'rw-mini',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'make record' }],
  functions: [{ name: 'make', parameters: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { id: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['id'] } }],
  function_call: { name: 'make', arguments: { id: 'abc123' } }
});
```

Sofia: wire capture shows payload sent: 
```
{"name":"make","arguments":{"id":"abc123","_sdk_ts":1689000000000}}
```
server: schema error: additional property `_sdk_ts` not allowed

Ben: thanks. which sdk/samplekit and any middlewares?

Sofia: js-sdk@0.9.9, samplekit v0.20-bootcamp, with our quickstart analytics middleware enabled in the container. py-sdk not affected (reported by a TA).

Aria: likely culprit is analytics middleware adding meta to the attempt object and then we accidentally shallow-merge attempt.meta into the function `arguments` when we rehydrate request on retry. can you grep middleware and the function-call serializer paths?

Sofia: quick grep found `analytics/annotateAttempt(attempt, body)` that does `Object.assign(body.arguments, attempt.meta)` in a retry path. oops.

Ben: yeah that's the bug. `attempt.meta` is internal and should never be merged into user arg objects. two fixes: (1) change middleware to annotate top-level request metadata in a non-conflicting header or separate envelope, (2) when serializing `arguments` ensure we `pick` only keys present in the schema or clone defensively.

Aria: agreed. immediate fix: stop merging meta into `body.arguments`. add unit test asserting that function-call payload contains only schema keys when `additionalProperties: false`. also add a devex test in samplekit bootcamp that runs quickstart with analytics enabled.

Sofia: opened draft PR with fix + tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/344 (WIP). change is one line in sdk/middleware/analytics.ts plus a unit in sdk/tests/function_call.spec.ts. PR includes a tiny reproduction script for TAs.

ci-bot: pipeline 12: samplekit-js build #712 queued (logs: https://ci.internal/samplekit/712)

Ben: locking note: this flaw will surface in any strict `additionalProperties:false` schema. we should also add a quick lint in SDK that flags middleware calling `Object.assign` into `body.arguments`. maybe a static check or code comment for library authors.

Aria: good idea. file an infra ticket to add a eslint rule in the SDK monorepo to disallow `Object.assign\(.*body\.arguments` patterns. lower friction to prevent regressions.

Sofia: short-term bootcamp workaround: set QUICKSTART_ANALYTICS=off in the container image and push a troubleshooting note in the docs. I updated the bootcamp README with a line: "If you hit schema errors in quickstart, try quickstart with analytics disabled."

Ben: planning: 1) land PR in samplekit, 2) cut a patch release for bootcamp image, 3) add eslint rule and a unit parity test comparing JS/Py assembled function-call payloads under analytics on/off, 4) add a short changelog note.

Aria: will review PR and help with the eslint rule. mark P1 for patch window if we can't ship hotfix within 48h.

Sofia: thanks all. I'll update PR with tests and CI artifacts. leaving the tiny repro script in the PR. :sparkles:
